Visitor replaces heading with custom format

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

final class LocalVisitor_VisitorCustomHeading: HtmlVisitorProtocol {
    func visitHeading(_ ctx: HtmlToMarkdown.NodeContext, _ level: UInt32, _ text: String, _ id: String?) -> VisitResult { return .custom(field0: "--- \(text) ---") }
}

let _visitorHandle_options = makeHtmlVisitorHandle(LocalVisitor_VisitorCustomHeading())
let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJsonWithVisitor("{}", _visitorHandle_options)
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h2>Section Title</h2><p>Content below heading.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
